text:
incident-bot: PAGE FIRED - PagerDuty PD-4829 for service embeddings-eu. Symptoms: increased 5xx and 429s from embeddings queue, tail latency 3-10s, error rate spike at 23:12 UTC. Runbook: /runbooks/embeddings-queue-backpressure. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4829  

pagerbot: automatic acknowledgement pending. Escalation policy: eu-inference -> oncall -> ops-lead.

Priya: acked on PagerDuty and jumping in. I see spikes in queue depth on the EU embeddings pool from CloudMetrics. @Aisha @Ben tagging you because this might need capacity scale or fallback to US. :eyes:  

Aisha: oncall here, I can take if Priya needs handoff. quick check: are customers getting 5xx or 429s? any specific routes impacted?

Priya: both 5xx (internal errors) and 429 (resource throttled) reported. Partial customer impact: EU region only so far. Customers using large batch embeddings most affected. 23:10 -> 23:18 window shows spike.

Ben: looking at nodes — embeddings-workers-eu-0/1/2 show high CPU and OOM kills on worker 1. paste logs: ```
2026-03-15T23:14:22Z embeddings-worker-1 ERROR kvcache: failed to allocate 512MB
2026-03-15T23:14:25Z embeddings-worker-1 WARN oomkiller: evicting process
2026-03-15T23:14:26Z embeddings-worker-1 ERROR http: 500 internal server error
```

Eli: adding metrics: queue_length_eu=1240 (baseline 40), token_rate=3.1M/s, backlog age ~45s. Looks like prefix/KV cache thrash leading to OOMs when large batch requests land.

Priya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale up embeddings pool by +4 nodes in EU (hot), 2) enable fallback routing -> embeddings-us for new requests, 3) add temporary rate cap on large-batch endpoints. I'll run scale and routing unless anyone objects.

Aisha: agree with plan. I'll own failover routing once scale starts. Ben - can you confirm autoscaler is green? run: `kubectl get hpa -n inference embeddings-eu`

Ben: HPA shows desired=6 current=2, can't scale due to quota hit in EU project. I'll request quota bump now and trigger manual scale. Running: `gcloud compute instances resize-pool --region=eu-west1 --count=6`  

pagerbot: PD note: Priya acknowledged PD-4829 at 23:15 UTC, priority set to P1. Escalation sent to ops-lead after 5m.

Priya: executed manual scale-up command and spun 4 extra workers, logs show new pods coming up: embeddings-worker-4/5/6/7 Ready. Starting traffic drain from overloaded nodes.

Eli: metrics after scale (23:21): queue_length_eu=210, token_rate steady, error_rate dropping. Beginning to route new large requests to embeddings-us (gradual).

Aisha: routing change applied via SmartRouter policy set: region_fallback=us for embeddings-large-batch. Monitoring for increased latency to US. Notifying customer success.

ops-oncall: quick FYI — created a temporary alert suppression for duplicate pages while we stabilize. suppress window 20m.

Priya: customer-impact note for PD: partial degraded embeddings (EU) affecting large-batch customers; mitigation: scale and region fallback applied; observed error rate down 85% from peak. Will keep PD open until stable for 30m.

Ben: saw one more OOM on old pod being terminated. Killed noisy batch session (id: sess-9f3a) that looked like runaway. Applied per-session size limit on ingress.

Eli: tail latency back to 200-400ms for most requests. No new 500s in last 6m.

Aisha: I'm taking ownership for the next 45m while Priya heads to a quick break. @Priya I have the escalation context and run commands. Priya: please drop a note with follow-up actions.

Priya: handing off to Aisha — everything documented in the incident timeline. I'll follow up with a postmortem draft (root cause hypothesis: KV cache pressure from high-concurrency large-batch embeddings + EU resource quota + no automatic fallback). Thanks all. :heart:

pagerbot: PD-4829 remains acknowledged and assigned to Aisha. Next status ping in 10m.

Aisha: confirming stable at 23:36 UTC. Continuing to watch for 30m. If error rate remains low I'll close PD and open a follow-up ticket for runbook improvements and quota request.

Priya: noted - follow-ups: (1) add automated fallback to region on queue depth threshold, (2) tighten per-request batch size limits and add graceful rejection, (3) request permanent EU quota increase, (4) add extra observability on KV cache evictions. I'll put these into a follow-up JIRA.

Ben: leaving a short config snippet that we used to cap batch size (so it's in chat): ```
# temp ingress cap
ingress:
  embeddings-large-batch:
    max_items_per_request: 500
    max_total_tokens: 100000
```

Eli: thanks - will include that in postmortem.

incident-bot: NOTE: PD-4829 status: acknowledged -> ongoing -> mitigated (observed). Next: postmortem assigned.

Aisha: closing the live thread for now, will update PD when we have 30m of stable metrics. Great teamwork. :clap:
